$schema_doc: Placement constraints for the W25Q16 QSPI flash (U4) and its decoupling cap (C34) vs the RP2040 (U3). Run `python3 hardware/pcb/v2/tools/check_flash_placement.py`. RP2040 datasheet chapter 2.8 recommends flash as close as possible to minimize QSPI trace length at 62MHz default clock.

constraints.rationale: Flash chip placed near U3 QSPI_SD0 pin (the most bandwidth-critical signal). RP2040 datasheet 2.8.1: 'The QSPI flash should be placed as close to the chip as possible'.

Flash Vcc (pin 8) close-in decoupling. W25Q16 datasheet recommends one 100nF per VCC pin at the pin. Relaxed to 3.5mm because U4 is SOIC-8 (1.27mm pitch) and the 0402 cap has to sit beyond the lead pad envelope; 3mm is the practical minimum.
